title: Monthly partition migration for the order history table and overnight reindex
goal: As the order history table grew, range queries got slow; split 24 months into monthly partitions and finish with an overnight reindex. After the migration, compare per-partition row counts and query plans against before.
doneWhen: The 24-month partition migration and overnight reindex finish, and the per-partition row count comparison and query plan verification pass.

items.label: Scope fixed
items.title: Migration scope and criteria fixed
items.body: Split 24 months of the order history table into monthly partitions and set the boundary month and retention period to match DATA-415. The write path is not locked during migration; consistency is judged by a post-migration comparison.

items.label: DDL prep
items.title: Partition DDL written and rehearsed
items.body: Wrote the monthly partition definitions and the migration script, then ran them on 3 months in a staging copy to check processing order and lock time.

items.label: History migration
items.title: 24-month history migration
items.body: Moved 24 months in batches during a low-traffic window, 40,000 rows per batch. New orders arriving during the migration are written to both sides and checked in the comparison.

items.label: Row count compare
items.title: Per-partition row count comparison
items.body: Matched per-partition row counts and the values of a 20,000-row sample from the last 7 days against the source, with no mismatches. Also confirmed from the execution plan that partition pruning applies to range queries.

items.label: Partition migration
items.title: Running the partition migration on the production table
items.body: Attached monthly partitions to the production order history table and moved 18 months. Move the remaining 6 months in the same order, then move on to the overnight reindex.

items.label: Overnight reindex
items.title: Overnight reindex
items.body: Rebuild the indexes on the migrated partitions and compare query response times before and after reindexing with the same query.

items.label: Result report
items.title: Migration result report and close
items.body: Collect per-partition row counts, query plans, and response times before and after reindexing, report them on DATA-412, and close the task.
